criteria.text: A small product can start without shared world or shared seed files, using its part data or an empty world.
An unrelated Notes table does not change who may write orders.
If a tap could need more than 40 AI calls, PDD refuses before upload; a tap needing exactly 40 remains eligible.
Malformed, unsafe or ambiguous source settings give an explanation and leave my files unchanged.

cases.given: One phone map; no contracts/world.md and no contracts/seed-world.json; first no part seed, then phone seed {orders:[]}.
cases.required_observation: Compose without changing authored files; worlds are {} and {orders:[]} respectively.

cases.given: A writer table assigns orders to server; a separate Notes table has Key and Note columns.
cases.required_observation: Only the writer table supplies ownership; no empty-Writer error.

cases.given: Admitted handler, after chain and rendering with total bounds 40 and 41.
cases.required_observation: 40 remains eligible; 41 refuses before upload and provider dispatch. Count internal model calls and rendering.

cases.given: Unsafe path, malformed map, two writer tables, conflicting part seed ownership in separate cases.
cases.required_observation: Finite actionable refusal; zero writes and no upload.
